approval.decision: M22.9 owner authorisation: G10 thresholds approved for candidate 2

scope.environment: W1, Chromium 153.0.8010.12 headless via Playwright 1.63.0, DPR 1
scope.limit: These thresholds apply to candidate 2 in this rendering environment only; they are not to be generalised to other candidates, machines, fonts or browsers.

rule: INVISIBLE when salience < 1.25 or coverage@1.25 < 0.005; VISIBLE (visibly acceptable) only when salience >= 1.5 and coverage@1.25 >= 0.005; otherwise BORDERLINE. Missing metrics, mismatched hashes or incomplete coverage fail closed.
